versions.changelog: Preserve decision-critical requirements, conflicts, evidence gaps, ownership and exact source links when shortening packets; add a synthetic compression-loss evaluation and synchronize portable ChatGPT instructions.

Check problem framing and business/People ownership; lead with the ask and decided/open state; default to a concise brief with optional appendix; add four evaluation cases and a synthetic before-and-after example.
Initial public release: evidence-backed HR decision packets with human authority, privacy boundaries, synthetic examples, and adversarial evals.
